messages:
Maria (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — I'm re-running the quarterly access evidence collection for infra projects this afternoon. Will pull IAM bindings, KMS grant history, and a 90d slice of audit logs. Need owners + one-line justification for any admin scopes by EOD Tue. @eng-oncall FYI.

Ken (infra): Do we include delegated KMS grants (cross-account) or only local keybindings?

Maria (sec-eng): We include both. Export captures grant history (creation/revocation) not just current bindings. If you want to exclude short-lived delegations, use the --min-age flag. Example: 
```
./tools/access_export --since 2026-01-01 --include-kms --format csv --min-age 30d 
```
This will omit grants created <30 days ago.

access-audit-bot: Job started: job_id=job-20260323-77, exporting 34 projects, ETA ~18m. (will post CSV to /shared/sec/reports) :gear:

Oliver (cloud): For the audit logs, can you confirm we’re stitching CloudTrail + GCP AdminActivity? Last time timezone skew made the timeline messy.

Maria (sec-eng): Yes — export normalizes timestamps to UTC and adds provider tags. We also produce an event map file so you can join by resource name + canonical timestamp. Watch for resources that changed names; they get a mapping column.

Jess (platform): Last run flagged ~15 orphaned service accounts with admin roles. Will the new run auto-suggest actions or just show evidence?

Maria (sec-eng): It will annotate likely-orphans and propose remediation rows (suggested action: remove admin role, propose owner, or convert to ephemeral grant). Removals are not automated — we create a candidate PR in the iam-review repo that needs triage.

Ken (infra): If I approve the suggested PR, will that trigger alerts in oncall? I'm on call next week and don't want false positives.

Maria (sec-eng): Good call — approvals create a transient exception with TTL metadata (default 7d). Oncall alerting is suppressed for items tagged with exception:* until the TTL expires. We’ll record justification in the PR body.

access-audit-bot: Job complete: job_id=job-20260323-77, export CSV: /shared/sec/reports/4055556789-q1-evidence.csv, mapping: /shared/sec/reports/4055556789-map.json

Oliver (cloud): Thanks — will scan the mapping first and flag any cross-project name collisions.

Maria (sec-eng): Thanks all. I'll post a short spreadsheet and a link to the candidate PR in ~30m. Please add owner confirmations inline. :thumbsup:
